parameterDefinition.name: Temperature
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: ABNT NBR 17037:2023 reference expressed as an applicable indoor range.

criteria.methodNote: ABNT NBR 17037:2023 specifies 21 °C to 26 °C for indoor dry-bulb air temperature. This is a technical reference for indoor air quality, not a universal legal limit.
